items.name: core
items.title: Core
items.description: Design tokens, base styles (reset, focus ring, reduced motion), the Inter font, shared popup styles and the cx/dataFlag helpers. Every component depends on it.
items.docs: bitop-ui: import "@/components/ui/styles/bitop.css" once at your app entry (e.g. src/main.tsx), before other CSS. See the installation guide for the Vite/TypeScript requirements.

items.name: theme-neutral
items.title: Neutral theme
items.description: The default theme: cool slate neutrals with an indigo accent, light and dark (data-theme="dark").

items.name: theme-uf
items.title: UF theme
items.description: Opt-in University of Florida brand override (blue #0021A5, orange #FA4616) for light and dark. Apply with data-brand="uf".
items.docs: bitop-ui: import "@/components/ui/themes/uf.css" after bitop.css and set data-brand="uf" on <html>.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Stacked headings that show and hide panels (single or multiple open), with heading levels and reduced-motion-aware animation.

items.name: agent
items.title: Agent
items.description: Agent definition card: name, model, instructions, tools (accordion with input schemas) and output schema.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: Inline message with tone, title, actions and dismiss; ErrorAlert renders unknown errors.

items.name: app-shell
items.title: App shell
items.description: Collapsible sidebar, mode switch, workspace switcher, user menu, top bar and main landmark.

items.name: artifact
items.title: Artifact
items.description: Panel for generated content: header with title and actions, close button and a scrollable body.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.title: Aspect ratio
items.description: A box that keeps a width-to-height ratio and crops media inside it.

items.name: attachments
items.title: Attachments
items.description: File chips with image previews, size, upload state and a remove button.

items.name: audio-player
items.title: Audio player
items.description: Native audio with custom controls: play/pause, skip, seek and volume sliders, mute and playback speed.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Image or initials avatar with circle and square shapes.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Badges, StatusBadge and StatusDot with shared tones.

items.name: breadcrumbs
items.title: Breadcrumbs
items.description: Breadcrumb trail with a current page and optional icons.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Button and IconButton: variants, sizes, loading and render-as-link.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button group
items.description: Joins related buttons into one named group with shared borders, horizontal or vertical, with separators and text segments.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: Dependency-free month grid with single, multiple and range selection, Intl month/weekday names, min/max and disabled dates, and APG date-grid keyboard support.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Card surface with header, body and footer parts.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: Dependency-free scroll-snap carousel with previous/next buttons, arrow keys, slide semantics and announcements.

items.name: chain-of-thought
items.title: Chain of thought
items.description: Collapsible timeline of an agent's steps with status, descriptions and search-result chips.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Checkbox and CheckboxGroup with labels, descriptions and indeterminate state.

items.name: checkpoint
items.title: Checkpoint
items.description: Conversation divider marking a saved state, with a restore action.

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code block
items.description: Code with a language label, copy button, optional line numbers and a pluggable highlighter.

items.name: color-field
items.title: Color field
items.description: Hex colour input with a native picker, preset swatches and a live WCAG contrast check.

items.name: color-mode
items.title: Color mode
items.description: Light/dark mode hook, no-flash script and a toggle button.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: Filterable select for long option lists: single or multiple (chips), groups, empty state and a clear button; works inside Field.

items.name: command-palette
items.title: Command palette
items.description: Cmd/Ctrl+K palette with grouped, filterable commands.

items.name: commit
items.title: Commit
items.description: Commit summary with copyable hash, author, relative time and a collapsible list of changed files.

items.name: confirmation
items.title: Confirmation
items.description: Tool-approval card: request with approve/reject actions, then an announced accepted or rejected outcome.

items.name: context
items.title: Context
items.description: Context-window usage ring and card with a meter, token breakdown (input, output, reasoning, cached) and optional cost.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context menu
items.description: Right-click / long-press menu with items, link items, checkbox and radio items, submenus, groups, shortcuts and a danger tone.

items.name: conversation
items.title: Conversation
items.description: Chat message log that sticks to the bottom while content streams, with an empty state, scroll-to-latest button and a screen-reader announcer.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: Copy button
items.description: Icon button that copies text and announces the result; useCopyToClipboard for custom triggers.

items.name: copy-field
items.title: Copy field
items.description: Read-only value with a copy button and a live status message.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data table
items.description: Typed data table with sortable headers, row selection, a text filter and pagination, built on Table.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date picker
items.description: A trigger button that opens a Calendar in a popover; single or range, Intl-formatted value, works inside Field.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Dialog and AlertDialog with focus trapping, sizes and busy/error states.

items.name: direction
items.title: Direction
items.description: DirectionProvider and useDirection for right-to-left layouts in Base UI components.

items.name: disclosure
items.title: Disclosure
items.description: Collapsible section with a summary of its current values.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: Edge-attached panel (bottom, top, left or right) with swipe-to-dismiss, snap points and header, body, footer and close parts.

items.name: drop-zone
items.title: Drop zone
items.description: Keyboard-operable file picker with drag and drop as an enhancement.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty state
items.description: Icon, title, description and actions for empty views.

items.name: environment-variables
items.title: Environment variables
items.description: Env var list with masked values, show/hide per variable and for all, copy and required badges.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Field, Fieldset, Form and FormActions that wire labels, descriptions and errors.

items.name: file-tree
items.title: File tree
items.description: Expandable folder/file tree with WAI-ARIA tree semantics, keyboard navigation, type-ahead and selection.

items.name: format
items.title: Format
items.description: Locale-aware, never-throwing Intl helpers: formatDate, formatNumber, formatBytes, formatRelativeTime and plural.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover card
items.description: A rich preview of a link's destination, shown on hover or focus after a delay.

items.name: image
items.title: Image
items.description: AI-generated image from base64, bytes or a URL, with required alt text, a loading placeholder and aspect ratio.

items.name: inline-citation
items.title: Inline citation
items.description: Numbered citation chip that opens a source card on hover or activation, paging through several sources.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Input, Textarea and NativeSelect controls.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input group
items.description: An Input or Textarea with leading and trailing addons (icons, text, buttons, key hints) inside one control boundary; works inside Field.

items.name: input-otp
items.title: Input OTP
items.description: One-time-code field with one slot per character, grouping, numeric or alphanumeric validation and paste support; works inside Field.

items.name: item
items.title: Item
items.description: Flexible row with media, title, description and actions; renders as a link for navigation lists.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: Keyboard keys and platform-aware shortcuts.

items.name: layout
items.title: Layout
items.description: Stack, Inline and Container layout primitives.

items.name: loader
items.title: Loader
items.description: Pulsing dots for pending chat states; decorative unless labelled.

items.name: marker
items.title: Marker
items.description: Inline conversation marker: status, system note, bordered row or labelled separator.

items.name: menu
items.title: Menu
items.description: Dropdown menu with items, link items, checkbox and radio items, submenus, groups, separators and a header.

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menubar
items.description: Application-style menubar of menus with items, checkbox and radio items, submenus and shortcuts.

items.name: message
items.title: Message
items.description: A chat turn: user bubble or assistant prose, avatar, action buttons (copy, feedback, retry) and response branches.

items.name: mic-selector
items.title: Mic selector
items.description: Microphone picker over mediaDevices with a permission prompt, live device updates and an unsupported fallback.

items.name: model-selector
items.title: Model selector
items.description: Searchable model picker grouped by provider, with capability badges (Base UI Combobox).

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: Navigation menu
items.description: Site navigation with top-level links and triggers that reveal content panels in a shared animated popup; links can render router links.

items.name: number-input
items.title: Number input
items.description: Text input for amounts with thousands separators while not editing, an optional unit, and locale-aware parsing.

items.name: open-in-chat
items.title: Open in chat
items.description: Menu of links that open a prompt in ChatGPT, Claude, v0 and other chat apps; providers are configurable.

items.name: package-info
items.title: Package info
items.description: Dependency change card: name, current to new version, change-type badge, description and dependencies.

items.name: page-header
items.title: Page header
items.description: Page title with breadcrumbs, meta, description and actions.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Pagination landmark with previous/next, page links, ellipsis and a page-range helper; links or buttons.

items.name: plan
items.title: Plan
items.description: Collapsible plan card with titled steps, statuses, footer actions and a streaming state.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Popover with title and description.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: Labelled determinate and indeterminate progress bar.

items.name: prompt-input
items.title: Prompt input
items.description: Chat composer form: autosizing textarea (Enter to send, IME-safe), toolbar, attachments and a status-aware send/stop button.

items.name: question
items.title: Question
items.description: A question the agent asks the user: single choice, multiple choice or freeform, with an optional Other answer and submit/skip callbacks.

items.name: questionnaire
items.title: Questionnaire
items.description: A multi-step flow over questions with progress, back/next/skip, a review step and a submit callback; focus moves to each step heading.

items.name: queue
items.title: Queue
items.description: Collapsible list of queued messages or to-dos with completion state and row actions.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio group
items.description: Radio group with default and card variants.

items.name: reasoning
items.title: Reasoning
items.description: Collapsible model thinking that opens while streaming, closes when done and reports how long it took.

items.name: resizable
items.title: Resizable
items.description: Resizable panel groups with draggable, keyboard-operable splitter handles and persistable layouts.

items.name: response
items.title: Response
items.description: Streaming-safe Markdown for assistant answers: GFM, code blocks, safe links, citation markers, no raw HTML; LazyResponse code-splits the Markdown engine.

items.name: sandbox
items.title: Sandbox
items.description: Collapsible code-execution panel with a status badge and Code / Output tabs.

items.name: save-bar
items.title: Save bar
items.description: Sticky bar with a form's Save and Discard actions, shown while there are unsaved changes.

items.name: schema-display
items.title: Schema display
items.description: API endpoint or JSON Schema display with parameters, request/response bodies and nested collapsible properties.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll area
items.description: Scroll container with slim custom scrollbars; keyboard-focusable and named when it scrolls.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Custom select for options with rich content.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: Horizontal or vertical separator with an optional label.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A modal dialog that slides in from an edge of the screen, with a required title and description, footer and close button.

items.name: shimmer
items.title: Shimmer
items.description: Animated text shimmer for in-progress labels; static under reduced motion.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Skeleton and SkeletonText loading placeholders.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Single or range slider with min/max/step, orientation, a required accessible name and an optional value readout.

items.name: snippet
items.title: Snippet
items.description: One-line command with a decorative prompt and a copy button.

items.name: sources
items.title: Sources
items.description: Collapsible "Used N sources" list with titles, links, snippets and citation numbers.

items.name: speech-input
items.title: Speech input
items.description: Microphone toggle that transcribes speech with the Web Speech API or records audio for server transcription.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: Spinner and Loading status indicators.

items.name: stack-trace
items.title: Stack trace
items.description: Parsed error stack with error header, file:line:column frames, collapsed internal frames and copy.

items.name: stat-card
items.title: Stat card
items.description: Metric card with icon, delta, hint, details and an optional whole-card link.

items.name: suggestion
items.title: Suggestion
items.description: Prompt-starter pill buttons that wrap or scroll horizontally.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: Labelled switch with description and label position.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Table with caption, sticky header, density, numeric columns and empty state.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Tabs (underline and pills) and link-based NavTabs.

items.name: tag-input
items.title: Tag input
items.description: Text tags with an inline input: Enter or comma adds, Backspace removes, paste adds several, announced politely.

items.name: task
items.title: Task
items.description: Collapsible unit of agent work listing the items and files it touched.

items.name: terminal
items.title: Terminal
items.description: Terminal output with ANSI colours, streaming auto-scroll, copy and clear.

items.name: test-results
items.title: Test results
items.description: Test run summary with pass-rate bar, suites, test statuses and collapsible error details.

items.name: text-link
items.title: Text link
items.description: Underlined inline link with muted and external variants.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Toaster region plus the toast API and useToast hook.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A two-state (pressed) button with Button sizes; icon-only toggles require a label.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle group
items.description: A named group of toggles with single or multiple selection, arrow-key navigation, orientation and an optional joined style.

items.name: tool
items.title: Tool
items.description: Collapsible tool call with status badge, JSON parameters and result or error.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Tooltip with optional shortcut hint.

items.name: transcription
items.title: Transcription
items.description: Transcript segments with timestamps; highlights the segment at the current time and seeks on activation.

items.name: visually-hidden
items.title: Visually hidden
items.description: Content for assistive technology only.

items.name: voice-selector
items.title: Voice selector
items.description: Searchable text-to-speech voice picker in a dialog, with voice metadata and preview buttons.

items.name: web-preview
items.title: Web preview
items.description: Sandboxed iframe preview with back/forward/reload, an address field and a console panel.
